# The Magic Coffin

Internal comms, employee experience, people ops and fractional HRBP consulting for scale-ups. Fix culture gaps, align teams, make change stick.

## Pages

- [Home](https://themagiccoffin.com/): Internal comms, employee experience, people ops and fractional HRBP consulting for scale-ups. Fix culture gaps, align teams, make change stick.
- [Internal Communications](https://themagiccoffin.com/services/internal-communications/): Consulting, retainers and fractional support for internal communications.
- [Employee Experience](https://themagiccoffin.com/services/employee-experience/): Consulting, retainers and fractional support for employee experience.
- [People Operations](https://themagiccoffin.com/services/people-operations/): People operations audits, HR systems implementation (HRIS, onboarding, self-service) and fractional People Ops partnership for scale-ups without an in-house function.
- [Privacy Policy](https://themagiccoffin.com/p/privacy-policy/): How we, at The Magic Coffin, collect, use, and protect your personal data under the GDPR.
- [About us](https://themagiccoffin.com/p/about-us/): The Magic Coffin: a solo-run consultancy in Stockholm and Barcelona helping scale-ups fix internal communications, employee experience, people operations and fractional HR business partnering.
- [Services](https://themagiccoffin.com/services/): Internal communications, employee experience, people operations and fractional HRBP consulting, project work and retainers for scale-ups without an in-house People function.
- [Fractional HRBP](https://themagiccoffin.com/services/fractional-hrbp/): Fractional HR Business Partner for founders and People teams who need senior judgement on restructures, ER cases and culture, without a full-time hire.
